question:
Select the Venn diagram that best represents the relationship between:

Moon, Satellite, Celestial body
solution:
The Venn diagram that best represents the relationship between Moon, Satellite, and Celestial body is shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/266ffc4c9b71dfddfcb4faba5356e0c9232897ed41ba52acbd37a2dceceb33c6.png] 

A satellite is a subset of a celestial body because all satellites (natural and artificial) are celestial bodies.

The moon is a subset of a satellite because the moon is Earth's natural satellite.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
